name: BK-5Br-NM-AMT
summary: BK-5Br-NM-AMT, or βk-5Br-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-5-bromo-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-5-bromo-β-ketotryptamine, is a monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.
